content: OpenAI current GA embedding models: text-embedding-3-small (default dim 1536), text-embedding-3-large (default dim 3072), text-embedding-ada-002 (dim 1536, legacy, no dimensions param). The 'dimensions' request param truncates -3-small/-3-large output (e.g. -3-large can be reduced to 256 dims). Source: developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/embeddings.
